name: codeatlas-fixture-golden-repo
description: Golden-file fixture: exercises the full analyzeRepository pipeline end-to-end (graph, coupling, cycle, blast radius, complexity, LOC, churn, hotspot, risks) against one small realistic project. The actual git history used by the golden-file test is synthesized separately by packages/engine/tests/helpers/create-golden-fixture-repo.ts, which replays these files' content into a throwaway temp repo with fixed commit dates — these files are the static, reviewable source of truth for that content; there is no .git here.
